title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
message_html: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains ...
snippet: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

title: Bottomline brings USDC stablecoin payments into platform

title: Standard Chartered powered bank Mox appoints Anshul Sabherwal as CEO
message_html: Standard Chartered powered bank Mox appoints Anshul Sabherwal as CEO ...
snippet: The former head of product and payment of Standard Chartered Hong Kong Anshul Sabherwal has been appointed CEO of Mox, a digital bank licensed in Hong Kong, powered by Standard Chartered in partnership with PCCW, HKT and Trip.com.
